scope.detail: Plus this lane's own artifacts: the manifest, the .ops/sync file and this proof bundle. `packages/db/src/runtime-repositories.ts` is a Tier C EXACT path, which is why this lane is T1 rather than the T3 an earlier draft proposed. No workflow, no merge control, no containment setting, no migration and no deploy path is touched.

limits: This lane changes where team and player search READ from -- the provider `participants` observation layer instead of the empty canonical `teams`/`players` tables -- and not what the published `TeamSearchResult`/`PlayerSearchResult` interfaces promise. No caller signature changes.

It seeds nothing. The canonical `teams`, `players` and `player_team_assignments` tables remain empty under parked provider ingestion, deliberately; this lane makes the search paths agree with the data that actually exists rather than duplicating data into the tables that do not.

`getEventBrowse`/`searchBrowse` carry a separate participant-vs-canonical key mismatch. It is real, it is recorded, and it is OUT OF SCOPE here -- those paths are not in this lane's file_scope_lock and are not touched.

The staging receipt proves persistence and non-delivery for two submissions on a real database. It does not constitute the Milestone 1 pilot, which requires Griff's own browser against the deployed system.
